# Narratech GOAP NPC (MIT)

`src/goap.c` is an original C design that takes its problem framing (atoms, actions with preconditions/effects/cost, procedural preconditions, node cap, replanning from the current state) from the MIT-licensed plugin below, whose `Source/` tree is byte-identical to the owned Fab build `GOAP_4.27` (see `docs/decisions/goap.md` §2). No code is copied; the notice is vendored to close the license question.
